summary: Clash of Clans entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Clash of Clans

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Supercell states Clash of Clans is officially playable on PC through Google Play Games with the same gameplay as mobile, mouse controls, optimized graphics, high-end performance, and Supercell ID progress sharing. That makes PC the best archive capture route while preserving the live mobile game content.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Google Play Games on Windows with a Supercell ID, and record the live version/date because troops, events, upgrades, and balance are service-managed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content and balance change; use mobile only if PC access or account linking is impractical.
